title: Design System: FLI home, variant B (the programme bill)
scope: VARIANT ONLY: index-b.html. Does not govern the other pages; the root DESIGN.md and .impeccable/design.json remain authoritative unless the user adopts this direction site-wide. Colour scheme shared with the incumbent by the user's instruction.

display.purpose: Hero headline only; two fitted lines, condensed then expanded at 900.

headline.purpose: Section heads on a double rule.

title.purpose: Programme titles and half-sheet heads; programme titles breathe to width 84 on hover.

bill.purpose: Language and keyboard bills, balanced and fitted per line.

label.purpose: Stubs, arrow links, nav, plate numbers, footer heads.

nastaliq.purpose: Urdu-script language names, right to left, never width-stretched.

printersMarks.name: tear-edge
printersMarks.purpose: Top edge of the subscription sheet.

motion.name: ease-expressive
motion.purpose: Arrow nudges, programme-title width breathing, menu drop.

motion.name: colour-swap
motion.purpose: Reversals on stubs, nav cells, bill names, rows.

narrative.overview:
The page is the bilingual letterpress poster pasted up for every mushaira in Chitral and Gilgit: two inks on newsprint, billing FLI's mother tongues as headliners. Burgundy floods whole sheets and ivory reverses out of it; brass is a third ink that prints only where something can be done. Every section is its own pasted sheet, separated from its neighbours by a strip of sand wall, so the page reads top to bottom as a programme: who is on stage, the language bill, what's on, the record, notices, the library and keyboards, then a tear-off subscription stub and the printer's imprint.

Display type is Anybody wood type, uppercase and fitted to the full measure by the width axis first and size second, the way a compositor chooses wood type; billing lines never wrap ragged. Running text is Schibsted Grotesk. Language names FLI prints in Nastaliq appear in Noto Nastaliq Urdu, right to left, as FLI's own books spell them. Structure comes from flat ink fields and printer's rules (double rules, hairlines, perforations), never from outlined boxes, cards, gradients or rounded corners.

Density is poster-like at the top of each sheet (very large wood type at line-height under 0.9) and ledger-like underneath (full-width ruled rows, hairline lists, tabular numerals).
keyCharacteristics: Two inks plus one action ink: burgundy, ivory, brass.
Sheets pasted on a sand wall with visible seams.
Fitted wood-type billing lines that fill the measure exactly.
Double printer's rules (4px over 1px) opening every major block.
Numbered plate captions on every photograph.
Perforated stubs as buttons; a tear-off edge on the subscription sheet.

rules.name: The Arcade Rule
rules.body: Brass prints only where something can be done: stubs, hovered links, focus, selection. Never as the fill of a heading, a rule or a decorative field.

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Every sheet is either flooded burgundy with ivory reversed out, or a light paper [ivory or newsprint white) inked in burgundy. Text never sits on an in-between tint.

rules.name: The Never-Wrap Rule
rules.body: A billing line never wraps ragged. Hero lines, bill lines, ledger figures and the footer signature are each fitted to the full measure, width axis first, then size. Without JavaScript they may wrap; with it they fill edge to edge.

rules.name: The Wood-Type-Is-Uppercase Rule
rules.body: Anybody is set uppercase at 800 or above everywhere except the single mixed-case vision statement. Sentences belong to Schibsted Grotesk.

rules.name: The Pasted-Sheet Rule
rules.body: Sections are separate sheets meeting at visible sand seams. Never separate sections with shadows, gradients or outlined boxes.

rules.name: The Tanaka Plane Rule
rules.body: Structure is flat ink fields and printer’s rules. A group is made with a rule above it, never with a box around it.

dos: Do fit every billing line (hero, bills, ledger, footer signature) to the full measure, width axis first, then size.
Do keep brass for stubs, hovered links, focus and selection only (The Arcade Rule).
Do open every major block with the double rule (4px over 1px) in the current ink.
Do give every photograph a numbered plate caption saying what and where.
Do separate sections as pasted sheets with a sand seam (10px; 6px under 560px).
Do put a news category under its headline, never above it.
Do bill lists of languages as a fitted bill, not as tiles or cards.
donts: Don't use rounded corners, cards, outlined boxes, gradients or drop shadows.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow label above a headline.
Don't let a wood-type billing line wrap ragged.
Don't print headings, rules or decorative fields in brass.
Don't stretch Nastaliq on a width axis or set it in any face but Noto Nastaliq Urdu.
Don't use a photo hero, a stat row of numbers in boxes, or tabs.
